description.p: Ferramari is a video wallpaper for Linux, written in Rust. 🦀

Play local videos, streaming URLs or web pages as your desktop wallpaper, one source per monitor. It can pause or mute itself when a window is maximized, apply a blurred video frame as the GNOME static wallpaper, and restore your original background on exit.

p.strong: Major release: GTK removal complete, Iced UI, native event loop.

ul.li: GTK/GDK/WebKit fully removed from the server binary (0 GTK libs)
Iced UI replaces the GTK control surface (separate binary, D-Bus client)
Native event loop replaces glib::main_loop (recv_timeout + deadline bookkeeping)
Native wallpaper surfaces replace GTK ApplicationWindow (x11rb)
Native monitor enumeration replaces gdk::Monitor (x11rb RandR)
Web wallpapers gated behind web-wallpaper feature flag

description.p: Fullscreen windows now pause the wallpaper, on Wayland sessions too.

ul.li: The occlusion watcher runs on XWayland, so X11 games and players pause playback
Pausing really stops decoding: the player no longer runs invisibly at zero volume
The pause/mute switches are visible on Wayland sessions
A crashed web-process page is detected and reloaded instead of leaving a blank desktop

description.p: Streaming no longer re-runs yt-dlp on every reload.

ul.li: A resolved stream is cached per page URL and screen height for 15 minutes

description.p: Layout regression from 1.9.1: content was clipped at the right edge.
Initial public release with GTK control surface.
